prompt: What was the 2021 population of the birthplace of the leader of the party that won the 1869 Newfoundland general election?
answer:
The winning party was the **Anti-Confederation Party**, led by **Charles Fox Bennett**, who was born in **St. John’s, Newfoundland**.

According to the 2021 Canadian census, **St. John’s had a population of 110,525** (the wider census metropolitan area had 212,579 residents).
